title: Surface-confined FRET nanoplatform printed via pyro-EHD jet for stable and reproducible TNF-α detection
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,20304-20315
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA00144K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Stefania Carbone, Simone Russo, Anna Palma, Giuseppe Junior Mosca, Sara La Manna, Alessia Cugudda, Sara Coppola, Pier Luca Maffettone, Simonetta Grilli, Giuseppe Vitiello, Concetta Di Natale
A p-jet/F-ZnO 2D FRET nanoplatform enables surface-confined TNF-α detection by printing P52 microspots with fixed donor–acceptor spacing. The system ensures high reproducibility and sensitivity, achieving a 31 ng mL−1 limit of detection.
